verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents Secure Data Sharing, which lets other Snowflake accounts share objects with you without copying data, so third-party data can be queried in place alongside your own. Data Clean Rooms and distributable Native Apps point the same way. However, nothing in the evidence describes a marketplace for discovering or acquiring third-party datasets, which is the heart of the story. Missing for 10: a documented third-party dataset marketplace/listing catalog, documented enrichment workflows joining provider data with your own, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
